Reproduction_Steps: Run llama-server binary dynamically linked against libllama.so without LD_LIBRARY_PATH
Expected_Behavior: Process starts and binds to isolated port
Actual_Behavior: Process exits immediately with exit code 127 libllama.so not found
User_Impact: Users on Linux cannot run downloaded models with llama.cpp
State_Security_Consequences: Startup failure leaves installation in unverified or failed state
Recommended_Correction: Added get_runtime_env discovering library directories and passed env to Popen

Reproduction_Steps: Run check_model_plugin on machine with standard Docker
Expected_Behavior: Returns False when docker-model plugin is not installed
Actual_Behavior: Returns True because docker model --help exits with code 0
User_Impact: Doctor falsely reports Docker Model Runner is available
State_Security_Consequences: Misleading system diagnostics and failed execution plans
Recommended_Correction: Inspects docker info plugin list and verifies direct command without --help
